jobs.description:
Project description

You will take the lead on complex, multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects, with full responsibility for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety. The scope includes both new installations and major modifications to existing assets in the process industry.

Primary Tasks & Responsibilities

• Own industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through commissioning and final handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and handover to operations.
• Act as the single point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams, both internal and external, across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• Minimum 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in fields such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• Demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting and investment approval, and commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is mandatory.
• Strong hands-on experience with MS Project, including ownership of project planning rather than follow-up only.
• Academic working level, with strong analytical skills and a helicopter view.
Non-Technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full responsibility for your assignments.
• You bring strong leadership skills and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate effectively across all organisational levels.
• You have natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / Certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

📋 Tasks and responsibilities

You will lead complex, multidisciplinary industrial CAPEX projects in production, infrastructure and R&D environments, covering the full lifecycle from concept and feasibility through commissioning and handover. The scope includes both new installations and major modifications to existing process-industry assets.

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility to commissioning and operational handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and handover.
• Act as the single point of accountability for stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.
• Ensure quality and safety standards are maintained throughout execution.

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• Minimum 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil.
• Demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies.
• Demonstrated experience with CAPEX budgeting and investment approval.
• Demonstrated experience with commissioning industrial installations.
• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on experience with MS Project, including ownership of project planning.
• Academic working level with strong analytical skills and helicopter view.
• You work autonomously, take full ownership and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
• You have the authority to challenge stakeholders and contractors in complex industrial environments.
• VCA-Vol is mandatory; PMP or Prince2 is a plus.
• Fluent Dutch and English are required.
• On-site presence in Olen is required.

Main missions:
 
 

• Support for customers for technical questions about existing or future products and/or services mainly in the residential segment. 

• Preparation of pre-design and material lists for drawing up quotations 

• Informing customers proactively about product changes 

• Maintain network technical contact points at customers 

• Building up knowledge about existing and new products and solutions 

• Internal contact point for product knowledge 

• Proactively communicate new items/innovations within the product portfolio for the BU Residential. 

• Offer support in the realization of residential projects (kick-off meeting, analysis of specifications, proposal, planning, etc.). 

• Provide training and support/back up for the Solar Academy training courses 

• Preparation of complex quotations 

• Management of technical files in SalesForce 

Requirements
 
 

• A master’s degree in Electro-technics, civil or industrial engineering or similar qualifications 

• Residing in Belgium 

• Minimum 2 years experience in a technical environment 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. Good knowledge of French, German is a plus 

• Stress resistant 

• Great team player 

• Customer-centric attitude

jobs.occupation: Sales Advisor Toyota City / Lexus Zaventem
jobs.description:
About us

Inchcape is the leading global automotive distributor operating in +40 markets. We partner with some of the biggest brands in the business to sustainably power better mobility today and in the future.

Our diverse global team of over 16,000 talented colleagues foster an inclusive and collaborative culture, delivering a brilliant experience for our customers and partners. We're a dynamic and fast-growing business, driving the transformation of our industry and redefining tomorrow.

Inchcape Belux employs over 250 team members. Our portfolio includes vehicle distribution for world-renowned brands, market leading fulfilment solutions, exceptional retail experiences, and tailored financial services.

 

Do you want to develop world-class skills, build a brilliant career, and thrive within a highly supportive team? Join Inchcape Belux, part of Inchcape's global network.

You'll play a key role in delivering outstanding customer experiences while representing one of the world's most trusted automotive brands. You'll be part of a dynamic team where collaboration, performance, and customer satisfaction are central.

Our Toyota City Zaventem team is looking for a Sales Advisor New Cars to support the sales of new Toyota and Lexus vehicles. In this role, you will guide customers throughout their buying journey, actively manage leads, and ensure a seamless and professional sales experience.

What you'll do
 
• Drive showroom sales for both B2B and B2C customers. 
• Actively prospect and develop new fleet clients while ensuring close follow‑up of all B2B and B2C leads. 
• Handle daily leads in line with brand standards and deliver strong performance on mystery leads, emails, calls, visits, and test drives. 
• Deliver excellent customer experience by informing, advising, and following up professionally, building long‑term trust and satisfaction. 
• Act as a Toyota Brand Ambassador in the showroom, during events, and on social media, with a polished appearance and courteous behaviour. 
• Apply Toyota's Omotenashi principles to create a warm, personalised customer experience. 
• Ensure flawless test drives and a smooth, high‑quality delivery process for customers. 
• Upsell additional products and services such as financing, insurance, and accessories. 
• Complete all administrative tasks accurately and in line with internal procedures. 
• Contribute to high customer recommendation and online reputation scores by consistently delivering top‑tier service. 
 

 

About you

To be successful in this role you will be:
 
• Passionate about the automotive industry and eager to build a career in sales. 
• Results‑driven and proactive, motivated to seize every sales opportunity. 
• Experienced in a customer‑facing role where customer satisfaction was the top priority. 
• Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment. 
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good knowledge of English.

Our client specializes in sustainable insulation materials and provides customers with a complete insulation solution.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Blowerdoor Technician, you will be responsible for carrying out airtightness tests on a wide range of construction projects. This role combines technical fieldwork with customer interaction and technical advisory services. 

Your responsibilities: 

• Performing blower door tests at residential homes, apartment buildings, retail stores, and other construction projects. 
• Using specialized testing equipment to measure the airtightness of buildings and identify air leakage. 
• Interpreting test results and preparing clear, accurate technical reports. 
• Explaining the results to customers and providing technical advice on potential improvements to enhance a building's airtightness. 
• Working independently on-site while ensuring a high-quality, accurate and customer-focused execution of all measurements. 
• Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers and acting as their technical point of contact throughout the testing process. 

The ideal Junior Blowerdoor Technician: 

• A junior profile with a technical background, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Construction or another relevant technical field. 
• Previous experience with blower door testing is not required. Motivation and willingness to learn are far more important. 
• A strong interest in engineering, construction, and building technologies, combined with a proactive, independent, and responsible mindset. 
• Good communication skills in French, with added knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• A flexible attitude, including the willingness to start early, work occasional evenings, and weekends. 
• Based in the Brussels or Flemish Brabant region, with the willingness to travel to construction sites throughout Belgium.

• Register and track customer issues within Salesforce and ensure appropriate follow-up actions are taken.
• Coordinate closely with Logistics and Warehouse teams to resolve order and delivery-related issues efficiently.
• Support knowledge sharing and participate in market-specific training initiatives.
• Contribute to team performance by maintaining a customer-focused mindset, supporting colleagues, and working towards established KPIs.

We are looking for:

• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, or a related sales administrative role.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, with a good command of Portuguese.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Experience with ERP systems is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Registered Nurse at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Mission in Belgium is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the position of Registered Nurse in the Health Unit.

Jobomschrijving

The jobholder serves as the post’s nurse with responsibilities that include the medical care of Mission employees and eligible family members, utilizing MED approved clinical guidelines, as well as maintenance and inventory of all medical equipment and supplies, implementation of a robust vaccination program, documentation through the global electronic medical record, system administration of group and individual health education programs, and medical emergency contingency planning for the Mission.

EDUCATION: Degree in Nursing (RN level) or Diploma/Certificate equivalent.
EXPERIENCE: 2 years post-qualification clinical work as a professional nurse within the last 10 years.
LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English.

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?

Then this might be your new challenge!



You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.



As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.



- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.

- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.

- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.

- You work with an electric pallet truck.

- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.

You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.

You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.

You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.

You enjoy active work.

You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

No diploma required.
